hero.title: Your data, on your terms.
hero.body: This policy explains in plain language what RetailAI collects, why we collect it, and the controls you have. No legal maze, no hidden clauses.

principles.title: Minimal by default
principles.body: We only ask for what an order actually needs — nothing collected "just in case".

principles.title: Encrypted in transit
principles.body: Voice orders, chats and payment details are encrypted end to end.

principles.title: Never sold
principles.body: Your personal data is never sold, rented or used for ad profiling.

principles.title: Always revocable
principles.body: Export or delete your data whenever you want, straight from your profile.

sections.title: Information we collect
sections.body: Your name, contact details, delivery addresses and order history — only what is required to fulfil orders and improve your experience.

sections.title: How we use it
sections.body: To place and deliver orders, power live tracking, personalise suggestions and prevent fraud. We never build advertising profiles.

sections.title: Who can see it
sections.body: Only the business fulfilling your order and our payment partners, limited to the fields they need. Staff access is role-based and logged.

sections.title: How long we keep it
sections.body: We retain data only as long as needed to provide the service and satisfy legal obligations, then delete or anonymise it.

rights.title: Your controls
rights.body: Every right below is available from your RetailAI profile — no support ticket required.

items.label: See your data
items.detail: Review the profile, addresses and order history we hold.

items.label: Correct it
items.detail: Update your name, email, phone or addresses at any time.

items.label: Export it
items.detail: Request a machine-readable copy of your account data.

items.label: Delete it
items.detail: Close your account and erase your personal information.

contact.title: Questions about your privacy?
contact.body: Our privacy team responds within two business days.
